correctness.rationale: The alternating-word multiplication gives two equations at each degree below m and one summed equation at m. The first nonzero degree r with 2r<m must be odd, and one of a_r,b_r vanishes. On a_r nonzero, each odd total degree determines the next even-index sum a_j+b_j=0, and each even total degree determines b_j, with coefficient a_r. In the even-total-degree step both equations agree: the odd–odd convolutions agree by reversal and the even–even terms agree because both factors change sign. At the longest word there is one constraint for m odd; for m even the two terms add to 2A_m, so the last constraint disappears exactly in characteristic two. This gives the stated stratum dimensions. The closed high-degree piece is the whole tail for odd m and the single displayed plane quadratic times the tail for even m. In even braid length and characteristic two with d even, adding tU_(d-1) to a high-degree solution creates below the top only the potentially nonzero term proportional to t(a_d+b_d), which vanishes; the top contributions cancel. Hence this smaller central piece is not another component. All other pieces contributing components have maximal dimension, and disjoint dense locally closed strata cannot have equal irreducible closures. Counting the affine factors, nonzero leading coefficient, and split/nonsplit lines gives all three rational-point formulas. Analytical replay: RESULT.md lines 35–67.
